values.housing.lengthMm: Photo calibration (SPEC 6.5): 'T-Cobbler and BreadBoard - Image 1.jpg' (SHA-256 a1d88400...cc98), M-F bundle's female end: 10 adjacent housings span about 174 px, so 2.54 mm = 17.4 px (6.85 px/mm); housing length about 82 px = 12.0 mm. +/-1 mm for edge blur and gaps between housings
values.malePin.sideMm: SPEC 6.5 and BB830 datasheet FAQ: a standard 0.1" header pin is 0.025" (0.64 mm) square
values.malePin.exposedMm: Same photo and scale: the bottom M-M ends' exposed pins measure about 37 px = 5.5 mm
values.wire: Secondary source (keszoox Dupont guide): jumper wire is typically 26-28 AWG; outer diameter about 1.0 mm in the same photo
values.minBendRadiusMm: Assumption for the reach check: a 26-28 AWG stranded lead turns within about 3 mm of its housing
values.inventoryLengthsMm: Listing photo and SPEC 6.5: the T-board kit's M-M and M-F leads are 200 mm
